body: Homedant USA Inc officially selected for DESIGN TOKYO 2026 - Booth L1-21! We're excited to announce that Homedant USA Inc will be exhibiting at DESIGN TOKYO ??part of LIFESTYLE WEEK TOKYO [Summer], June 24??6, 2026 at Tokyo Big Sight. DESIGN TOKYO isn't a show you simply apply for. A panel of professional designers and stylists evaluates every product against two criteria: ??Design quality ??aesthetic integrity and product philosophy ??Marketability ??real commercial viability in today's market Only brands that pass both are invited in ??making it a true invitation-only zone for high-quality international labels. We'll be presenting our K-Steel Shelving collection ??designed and manufactured entirely in Korea ??to retail buyers, interior professionals, and distribution partners entering the Japanese market. Also, there will be a huge promotion on some of our product lines during the exhibition week(6/24~6/26) at our Amazon Japan store! Attending Lifestyle Week Tokyo? We'd love to connect at Booth L1-21. body: We made it to Las Vegas. ?눣?눡 This past March, HOMEDANT USA exhibited at Hardlines Supplier Event 2026, a key trade show for the North American hardware and home improvement industry. It was more than just an exhibition for us. It was our first meaningful opportunity in 2026 to connect directly with the U.S. independent retail market ??buyers, distributors, category managers, and retailers who understand what works on the shelf. At Booth 2754, we introduced our K-Steel Shelving Solutions: Korean-made boltless steel shelving designed for strength, easy assembly, and practical use across home, garage, warehouse, and commercial spaces. The conversations we had confirmed one thing clearly: quality and real value still win in the independent hardware channel. Thank you to everyone who stopped by and connected with us. author: Leo Lee
body: Every space has potential. This video was shared by our creator partner as part of a gifted product collaboration with HOMEDANT. In this real-life use case, an awkward closet space was transformed into a more organized and functional storage area.
